newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine C. Bank keeps lid on peso offer rates.
newsitem.headline: Philippine C. Bank keeps lid on peso offer rates.

text.p: The peso, with the Central Bank's help, hardly budged in early trading on Tuesday and traders said even a sharp drop in the country's trade deficit was not enough to push it out of its very tight range.
"I think it will just trade sideways though some (dollar) buying might resume this afternoon," a Philippine bank trader said, noting oil companies needed dollars.
By mid-morning the peso was quoted at 26.375/377 to the dollar, a touch above Monday's close.
The Central Bank stuck to its 26.377 peso offer rate.
News of an almost 35 percent plunge in the country's April trade deficit from a year ago, had no impact.
"I think the market had already discounted the figure," one trader said.
